answer.reason: Lystra is where Paul healed a cripple and was stoned, events that go beyond the summary.

clauses.english: was where Paul healed a man crippled from birth, who leaped and walked
clauses.quote: Stand upright on thy feet. And he leaped and walked.

clauses.english: was where Paul was stoned and dragged out of the city, then rose up and returned
clauses.quote: having stoned Paul, drew him out of the city, supposing he had been dead.

doubts: ACT 14:11-18 (the crowd calling Paul and Barnabas gods) was elided in the given verses and not used.
Timotheus being well reported of at Lystra (ACT 16:1-2) was left out as a minor detail about a person.
